title: Resource
description: Something that exists (or existed) in a connected provider account: the truth side of the join.

id.description: Stable Muretto resource id: <kind>:<provider_id>. Deterministic, so two machines that see the same resource produce the same id.

provider.description: Provider slug from the adapter file, e.g. supabase or vercel. Not an enum: new adapters add providers without schema changes.

account_id.description: Provider org/team id the resource belongs to.

kind.description: Resource kind as <provider>.<kind>, e.g. supabase.table or vercel.deployment.

provider_id.description: Provider id or natural key, unique within the kind (e.g. project ref, dpl_ id, <ref>/<schema>.<table>).

parent_id.description: Stable Muretto resource id: <kind>:<provider_id>. Deterministic, so two machines that see the same resource produce the same id.

status.description: Provider status, lightly normalized (e.g. active, paused, building, ready, error).

created_at.description: Creation time reported by the provider; null when the provider doesn't report it.

existence.description: confirmed: seen by the last successful check. unconfirmed: known only from session evidence (e.g. a table without the opt-in catalog read). gone: missing from a successful check after being seen.

seen_via.description: How Muretto knows about it: a provider list call, a provider advisor/lint, or only agent evidence.

attributes.description: Kind-specific scalar attributes from the adapter field mapping (e.g. public, target, region). Never secret values.
